Warpack Forge

Searchable reference for the Steam auto-battler Warpack: items, units, keystones, commanders, skills, ascensions and synergies.

About the game

Warpack is an auto-battler from N1ghtmare Studios, on Steam with a free demo now and the full game due November 2026. You build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's 3×3 backpack so item shapes and adjacency combos line up, then feed your champions until they turn into monsters. Every fight is against a real player's saved army, so it's async PvP: no lobby, no waiting, just a ranked ladder to climb. Five factions, from Highcrest's knights and peasant levy to the Bone Legion's risen dead and the Bloodhorde's rage, each with its own commanders, skills and keystones. Warpack Forge is a fan-made reference for all of it: every item, unit and keystone, with the numbers the game leaves out.
